You are looking for an employer who takes you to the next level. You want to work on a team which values your ideas. You want to participate in developing and creating the future of BBHT Solutions. Then join us as
Senior Network Engineer
Your responsibilities
Ensure the reliable operation of switching, routing, and wireless network infrastructure across data centers and campus environments
Analyze and resolve network incidents and performance issues in accordance with defined SLAs
Execute planned configuration changes, software updates, and lifecycle activities (e.g., firmware upgrades)
Monitor network performance, perform capacity planning, and proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks
 Your Qualifications
A successfully completed university degree, ideally in computer science, or equivalent professional experience
Fluent knowledge of both German and English; a communicative and independent personality
Solid experience with Cisco Nexus switches (9000/7000/5000), including vPC, Spanning Tree, OSPF and BGP, as well as hands-on experience with Cisco ACI and APIC
Strong expertise in Extreme Networks Fabric, including SPB, IS-IS and Layer 2/Layer 3 VSNs, plus experience with enterprise wireless environments
Strong knowledge of routing, redundancy and network security, including MC-LAG, 802.1X, ACLs and RADIUS
Basic knowledge of network automation using Ansible, Python or Terraform; relevant certifications such as CCNP Enterprise/Data Center or equivalent and ECE in Campus Fabric and/or Wireless are considered a plus
 We offer you
A full-time position and the chance to collectively develop the company itself
Independent work, challenging & innovative projects with renowned clients
Qualified and continuing education, joint trainings and company events
Good work-life balance by flexible working hours and 25 days of vacation
Remote or hybrid work and high quality, personal IT infrastructure
 BBHT is an ambitious consultancy shaped by its employees, with offices in Cluj-Napoca (Romania), Münster and Frankfurt am Main (Germany). We specialize in project and process management, requirement engineering, business intelligence and quality assurance and regulatory reporting, our main focus being the banking and insurance sector. Our mission: to solve new challenges together with motivated people.
